text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"states an opinion, then weighs benefits against failures","quality":"argumentative balance","description":"It acknowledges both the promise of driverless-car technology and the risks, which makes the position more nuanced and persuasive."},{"evidence":"mentions wreck, careless driving, technology fails, test drive for about a year","quality":"supporting detail","description":"It uses several concrete details to support its claims rather than relying mostly on general statements."},{"evidence":"“what if the technology fails...?” and “will it work?”","quality":"counterargument awareness","description":"It raises a real objection to its own pro-driverless stance and shows awareness of uncertainty."},{"evidence":"“The company... needs to study and study” and “before releasing”","quality":"development of ideas","description":"It expands on the position with some explanation of what should happen next instead of stopping at a simple opinion."},{"evidence":"paragraphing and extended response","quality":"organization","description":"It is more developed as a multi-paragraph essay with a clearer progression from opinion to evidence to conclusion."}]}
